policy: The ledger stores sanitized portfolio memory metadata and references, not private payloads.
No outcome changes learned value until independently VERIFIED.
Rejected or unverified observations remain auditable but do not contribute to learned value.
Verified attribution for a single event is conserved across memories and may not exceed 1.0 in total.
Objective-specific memories do not silently generalize to unrelated objectives.
An empty ledger is preferable to fabricated verified outcomes.
